name: motiongo-v2
description: MotionGo V2 — Composition-based motion design editor and deterministic video renderer

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium && npm install --prefix renderer && npm install --prefix editor-v2
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "RENDERER,EDITOR,RENDER-API" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix renderer" "npm run dev --prefix editor-v2" "node render-api.js"
